# `network/realm/chronicle/RealmChronicle.js`

> **Source:** `engine/network/realm/chronicle/RealmChronicle.js`

RealmChronicle.js — signed SHA-256 causal history for a Realm branch. Chronicle events contain semantic records and state-root transitions, not simulation ticks.  The implementation is storage-agnostic so the same verification code is used for local persistence, Capsule import, and peers.
